quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that helps your hand grip a crayon to draw?
quests.question: Thumbs
quests.hint: Each hand has just one, and it is short and strong.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Thumbs help your hand grip things and can touch each of your other fingers!
quests.funFact: A thumbs up is a friendly way to say 'great job' around the world.

quests.instruction: Find the body part we use to hear birds singing and touch it!
quests.question: Ears
quests.hint: Think about this: Cover these and sounds become quiet.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Ears help you hear sounds like music and voices!
quests.funFact: Your ears never stop listening, even while you sleep!

quests.instruction: Find the body part we use to give a warm, big hug and touch it!
quests.question: Arms
quests.hint: Think about this: Your hands are found at the end of these.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Arms help you hug, wave, and carry things!
quests.funFact: You use over thirty muscles just to bend and lift your arms!

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part you rest on your hand when you are thinking hard?
quests.question: Chin
quests.hint: You rest this on your hand when you think.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Chin is the part at the very bottom of your face, below your mouth!
quests.funFact: Some people have a small dimple right in the middle of it.

quests.instruction: Find the body part you shrug when you are not sure of the answer and touch it!
quests.question: Shoulders
quests.hint: Think about this: They are found where your arms begin.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Shoulders are where your arms connect to your body, and help you shrug and lift!
quests.funFact: Your shoulders let your arms swing all the way around!

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that fills up with air when you take a big breath?
quests.question: Chest
quests.hint: It is between your shoulders and your tummy.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Chest is the front of your upper body, where your heart and lungs are!
quests.funFact: You can feel your chest rise and fall every time you breathe.

quests.instruction: Find the body part we use to taste yummy strawberries and touch it!
quests.question: Tongue
quests.hint: Think about this: It lives inside your mouth and moves when you talk.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Tongue helps you taste your food and speak clearly!
quests.funFact: Your tongue has thousands of tiny taste buds on it!

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that a grandparent might gently pinch to say hello!
quests.question: Cheeks
quests.hint: Hint: They turn rosy pink when you feel shy.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Cheeks are the soft round parts on the sides of your face!
quests.funFact: Cheeks turn pink or red when you blush.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that smiles big when you feel happy and proud!
quests.question: Face
quests.hint: Hint: You wash it every morning with water.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Face is the front of your head, with your eyes, nose, and mouth!
quests.funFact: Every single face in the world is a little bit different.

quests.instruction: Find the body part we use to clap and hold our toys and touch it!
quests.question: Hands
quests.hint: Think about this: They are found at the end of your arms.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Hands help you hold, clap, and catch things!
quests.funFact: Each of your hands has twenty seven tiny bones inside!

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that keeps your mouth closed when it is not talking!
quests.question: Lips
quests.hint: Hint: You press these together to blow a kiss.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Lips are the soft edges around your mouth that help you smile and talk!
quests.funFact: You use your lips to help make many different sounds when you talk.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that lets you fold your arm to eat your dinner!
quests.question: Elbows
quests.hint: Hint: They are between your shoulder and your wrist.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Elbows are the bendy joints in the middle of your arms!
quests.funFact: You bend your elbows every time you eat with a spoon.

quests.instruction: Find the body part we use to chew crunchy apples and touch it!
quests.question: Teeth
quests.hint: Think about this: They are hard, white, and live inside your mouth.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Teeth help you bite and chew your food!
quests.funFact: Children have twenty first teeth before their grown-up teeth arrive!

quests.instruction: Find the body part we use to smell fresh cookies baking and touch it!
quests.question: Nose
quests.hint: Think about this: You breathe air in and out through it.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Nose helps you smell and breathe in fresh air!
quests.funFact: Your nose can remember thousands of different smells!

quests.instruction: Tap the body part you twist gently when you wiggle your foot in a circle!
quests.question: Ankles
quests.hint: Hint: You bend these when you point your toes.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Ankles connect your feet to your legs and help you balance!
quests.funFact: You use your ankles every time you jump or hop.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that carries your backpack full of books!
quests.question: Back
quests.hint: Hint: You lie on this to look up at the sky.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Back is the part behind you that helps you stand up straight!
quests.funFact: Your back helps you stand up tall and straight.

quests.instruction: Find the body part we use to taste delicious ice cream and touch it!
quests.question: Mouth
quests.hint: Think about this: Your teeth and tongue live inside it.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Mouth helps you eat, talk, and smile!
quests.funFact: Your mouth helps you talk, eat, and smile every day!

quests.instruction: Find the body part we use to run and kick a soccer ball and touch it!
quests.question: Feet
quests.hint: Think about this: They are found at the end of your legs.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Feet help you stand, walk, and run!
quests.funFact: About a quarter of all the bones in your body are in your feet!

quests.instruction: Tap the body part you tap gently when you try to remember something!
quests.question: Forehead
quests.hint: Hint: It gets wrinkly when you look puzzled.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Forehead is the flat part of your face above your eyebrows!
quests.funFact: Your forehead protects the front part of your skull underneath.

quests.instruction: Find the body part we use to see colorful rainbows and touch it!
quests.question: Eyes
quests.hint: Think about this: Close these and everything turns dark.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Eyes help you see everything around you, like colors and shapes!
quests.funFact: Your eyes can notice millions of different colors!

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that lets you bend down low to tie your shoes!
quests.question: Knees
quests.hint: Hint: They are between your hip and your ankle.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Knees are the bendy joints in the middle of your legs!
quests.funFact: A small round bone called the kneecap protects the front of each knee.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that flutters every single time you blink!
quests.question: Eyelashes
quests.hint: Hint: They help keep dust out of your eyes.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Eyelashes grow along your eyelids and help keep dust out of your eyes!
quests.funFact: Eyelashes grow, fall out, and grow back again on their own.

quests.instruction: Find the body part we use to wiggle inside our socks and touch it!
quests.question: Toes
quests.hint: Think about this: They are found at the end of your feet.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Toes help you balance and push off the ground when you walk!
quests.funFact: You have ten toes, just like you have ten fingers!

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that stops sweat from dripping into your eyes!
quests.question: Eyebrows
quests.hint: Hint: They are small, thin lines of hair above your eyes.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Eyebrows sit above your eyes and help keep sweat and rain out of them!
quests.funFact: Each eyebrow has its own special curved shape.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that is shorter and thicker than your other fingers!
quests.question: Thumbs
quests.hint: Hint: It helps your hand grip things tightly.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Thumbs help your hand grip things and can touch each of your other fingers!
quests.funFact: Your thumb can bend and touch each of your other fingers.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part you shake gently when you wave a magic wand!
quests.question: Wrists
quests.hint: Hint: You bend these to wave your hand.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Wrists connect your hands to your arms and let your hands turn and wave!
quests.funFact: You use your wrists every time you turn a doorknob.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part found between your shoulders and your tummy!
quests.question: Chest
quests.hint: Hint: It fills with air when you breathe in.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Chest is the front of your upper body, where your heart and lungs are!
quests.funFact: A big, deep breath fills your whole chest with fresh air.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that sits on top of your neck and touch it!
quests.question: Head
quests.hint: Think about this: Your hat goes right on top of it.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Head is the part on top of your neck that holds your brain and face!
quests.funFact: Your head holds your brain, which helps you think and dream!

quests.instruction: Find the body part that connects your head to your shoulders and touch it!
quests.question: Neck
quests.hint: Think about this: You turn this to look behind you.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Neck connects your head to your shoulders and lets your head turn!
quests.funFact: Your neck lets your head turn almost all the way around!

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that is the lowest part of your face!
quests.question: Chin
quests.hint: Hint: It is right below your lips.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Chin is the part at the very bottom of your face, below your mouth!
quests.funFact: Your chin helps give your face its own special shape.
